references.text: Moses sent spies to explore the land of Canaan, just as Joshua sent spies to Jericho
Instructions to the spies to explore the land, parallel to the mission given to the spies in Jericho
Joseph accused his brothers of being spies who came to see the weak points of the land, the same accusation leveled against the spies in Jericho
The brothers were accused of being spies in Egypt, a similar situation to that of the spies in Jericho
Saul learned that David had arrived, just as the king of Jericho learned about the arrival of the spies
David's men were suspected of being spies sent to explore the land, the same suspicion held against the spies in Jericho
Rahab received the spies in peace, a reference to this event in Joshua
